facts.ja: Nvidiaは前四半期に約200億ドル、自社株買いを実行し、これはフリーキャッシュフローの約92%に相当する。
facts.en: Nvidia repurchased nearly $20 billion of its own shares last quarter, equivalent to approximately 92% of its free cash flow.
facts.quote: Nearly $20B repurchased last quarter, equivalent to ~92% of free cash flow.

facts.ja: Nvidiaは新たに1,500億ドルの自社株買いを承認し、残りの買い戻し枠は2,350億ドルとなっている。
facts.en: Nvidia just authorized an additional $150 billion for share repurchases, with $235 billion remaining in repurchase capacity.
facts.quote: Another $150B just authorized. $235B in remaining capacity.
